data.title: The Coral Collection
data.about:
The Coral Collection by Nakheel at Palm Jebel Ali offers an extraordinary living experience with its exclusive 7-bedroom villas. These luxury residences, nestled on the iconic Palm Jebel Ali, combine elegance and tranquility, providing direct access to a private beach. With eight distinct villa types, such as Villa Hibiscus and Villa Ruby Sunset, each home is designed to reflect personal preferences, ensuring comfort and sophistication in every corner.

These spacious three-storey villas are adorned with natural elements like wood, marble, and stone, creating a serene atmosphere. Residents will enjoy exclusive amenities, including a private infinity pool, outdoor dining area, and garden, all set against the stunning backdrop of the Dubai skyline. With a flexible payment plan available, The Coral Collection Villas by Nakheel redefines luxury living at Palm Jebel Ali.

characteristics_module.title: Ultra-Luxurious Villas with Private Beach Access on Palm Jebel Ali
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Luxurious 7-bedroom villas located on Palm Jebel Ali offering ultra-high-end living spaces.
  • Direct access to a private beach, ensuring an exclusive and tranquil beachfront lifestyle.
  • These villas consist of three storeys, providing expansive living areas of over 18,000 sq. ft, ensuring your comfort and space.
  • Panoramic views of the Dubai skyline from the most sought-after location.
  • Equipped with a private lift for convenience across all floors.
  • Eight unique villa designs allow homeowners to choose based on their preferences and style.
  • Outdoor spaces are meticulously landscaped, offering gardens, terraces, and ample space for relaxation or entertainment.

location_tile.title: Luxurious Beachfront Living: The Coral Collection Villas on Palm Jebel Ali
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
The Coral Collection Villas by Nakheel are located on Palm Jebel Ali's lower fronds, offering luxurious 7-bedroom beachfront homes. These exclusive villas boast private beach access and proximity to essential amenities like future schools, shopping centers, and entertainment venues. The development is well-connected via major highways, ensuring easy access to Dubai's key locations. With premium amenities and a serene lifestyle, these Coral Living Villas represent a prime investment opportunity for those seeking luxury living in Dubai's iconic Palm Jebel Ali.

  • Expo City Dubai – 15 minutes
  • Dubai Parks and Resorts – 15 minutes
  • Al Maktoum International Airport – 20 minutes
  • Dubai Marina – 25 minutes

seo.metaTitle: The Coral Collection Villas By Nakheel
seo.metaDescription: Experience luxurious living at The Coral Collection by Nakheel, offering exclusive 7-bedroom villas at Palm Jebel Ali, designed for premium comfort and elegance.

more_info.answer: The Coral Collection offers 7-bedroom luxury beachfront villas with private beach access and premium amenities on Palm Jebel Ali.
more_info.question: What types of villas are available in The Coral Collection by Nakheel?

more_info.answer: Amenities include private infinity pools, gyms, media rooms, outdoor dining areas, gardens, and direct beach access.
more_info.question: What amenities are provided by Nakheel in The Coral Collection Villas?

more_info.answer: These villas are situated on the lower fronds of Palm Jebel Ali, providing stunning panoramic views of Dubai's skyline.
more_info.question: Where are The Coral Collection Villas located on Palm Jebel Ali?

more_info.answer: As part of Nakheel’s luxury developments, these villas offer high-end features, a serene location, and, due to their exclusivity, potential for high resale value.
more_info.question: What makes The Coral Collection Villas a good investment?

more_info.answer: The starting price is AED 30.7 million, with a planned handover in November 2027.
